SOURCE_FIDELITY.meaning: An individually verified faithful representation of published stats and immediate narrative, including typed and located source silence, ambiguities, conflicts and explicit absences.
requires: Exact stable publication-source identity and printed page
Primary PDF close-read for statblock and applicable adjacent prose
All printed attack-group/source fields preserved without numeric derivation
Every source-silent mandatory value explicitly typed as SOURCE_SILENT_CONFIRMED with page scope
Missing historical keys distinguished from source-confirmed silence
Published conflicts retained with separate alternatives and provenance
Schema-compatible lossless evidence mapping and a passed per-ship validator

PHYSICAL_MOUNT_AND_AUTOMATED_STOCK_COMBA.meaning: Independent physical-mount/automation eligibility certificate for specific installed configuration and attack operation; never derived from source fidelity alone.
requires: Resolved certified physical mount identity and installed configuration
Resolved required firing geometry and per-attack applicable crew/gunner station
All target, operation, damage and battery semantics needed by runtime satisfied
Authority retained through trusted actor import and mutation-invalidating provenance
Foundry V13 live proof of implementation before operational authorization
forbids: Guessing physical barrels from attack groups
Treating an unprinted arc as forward/360 degree
Inferring battery members from stated number of batteries
Treating magazine payload as launcher count
Setting 0, None, false, [] or null as a substitute for missing evidence
Automated stock attack permission from uncertified ship
GM override transforming a sourcebook claim into a canonical certificate

evidenceStatePolicy.PRINTED_VALUE: Known nonzero numeric/text/boolean value exactly retained; interpretation remains separately gated.
evidenceStatePolicy.PRINTED_ZERO: Known numeric zero as recorded, not absence.
evidenceStatePolicy.EXPLICIT_NONE: Only when an exact verified explicit absence/none is recorded by the printed source; keep raw token.
evidenceStatePolicy.SOURCE_SILENT_CONFIRMED: Primary close-read affirmatively verified book omission; never equivalent to null/zero/no weapon.
evidenceStatePolicy.KEY_NOT_STORED: Field absent from historic ledger; unknown evidence status, not source silence.
evidenceStatePolicy.RECORDED_NULL_UNRESOLVED: Null stored in source ledger; require source annotation before asserting source silent or explicit none.
evidenceStatePolicy.RECORDED_DESCRIPTIVE_TEXT: Captured qualified narration (including partial arc evidence); preserve exact raw text without treating it as geometric automation.
evidenceStatePolicy.PUBLISHED_CONFLICT: Conflicting published values retained with provenance; no chosen numeric default without published errata or separately approved owner ruling.
evidenceStatePolicy.NOT_REVIEWED: Source not verified: cannot classify as SOURCE_SILENT_CONFIRMED.
evidenceStatePolicy.CONFIGURATION_CONDITIONAL: The fact applies only to named configuration/variant; explicit scope required.

implementationBoundaries.rule: Approval authorizes the certification standard, not bulk award of certificates or production schema freeze.
